expected_memories.content_gist: The RP2350 supports crystals from 1 MHz to 50 MHz
The RP2350 reference design uses a 12 MHz crystal
The PLLs can generate a 48 MHz clock meeting the USB frequency accuracy requirement and a 150 MHz maximum speed system clock
A minimum crystal frequency of 5 MHz is needed for the PLL
The recommended crystal for the RP2350 is the Abracon ABM8-272-T3
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a centre frequency of 12.000 MHz
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has an operating temperature range of -40 to +85 degrees Celsius
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a storage temperature range of -55 to +125 degrees Celsius
Compared with the RP2040, the maximum crystal frequency increased from 15 MHz to 50 MHz when the appropriate range is selected in CTRL.FREQ_RANGE
When the XOSC XIN pin is used as a CMOS clock input from an external oscillator the maximum is always 50 MHz and CTRL.FREQ_RANGE does not need configuring
expected_memories.condition: when XIN is used as a CMOS clock input rather than with a crystal

expected_memories.content_gist: The maximum clk_ref frequency is 25 MHz, and a crystal above 25 MHz used as the clk_ref source must be divided using the clk_ref divider
The XOSC is disabled at chip startup and the RP2350 boots using the ring oscillator, so the programmer must set CTRL_ENABLE to start it

The STARTUP_DELAY register specifies how many crystal clock cycles must be seen before the crystal can be used, in multiples of 256, and the 1 ms default suits the RP2350 reference design running the XOSC at 12 MHz

must_not_extract: the running footer (RP2350 Datasheet, 8.2. Crystal oscillator (XOSC), 555 and 556)
the figure caption prose describing how the amplified feedback drives the crystal into mechanical resonance
